title: HOLD THE COUNT
author: Ensemble
medium: A hold in the browser (canvas, Web Audio): the visitor presses and holds, is given one real quiet from the record at one second per day, may declare it over after 42, and the record writes the next 90 days.
embodies: Of 1,546 quiets in North Kivu and Ituri 2018-2020, 842 lasted one day and 60 reached day 42; a case came within the next 90 days in 28 of those 60. Of 2,027 quiets in eastern Congo 2026 to 29 Oct, 22 reached day 42: 11 broke within 90 days, 1 held, and for 10 the record ends first.
sources: https://github.com/frankbueltge/field-research/tree/main/artifacts/after-cycle-012/who-the-curve-speaks-for (the Field, study 56, session 254: data56.js, sha256 1b1c140f83172a7123af60b9d73534b1a2e58191f40a5e859b0b2668520cb63a, read as data by build.py; field-research HEAD 85f8a75 when fetched)

data_sources.what: The Field's study 56: every quiet of the Kivu 2018-2020 and Congo 2026 Ebola records (zone, rise day, days to the next rise), built from the open health-zone figures and the OCHA DRC daily file on HDX
The Atelier's quiets file; its records.kivuHole gives the 94 days with no report in Kivu, 8 Mar to 9 Jun 2020

atlas_neighbours: Pulse Room: Light Bulbs Show Heart Beats (Rafael Lozano-Hemmer, 2006)
atlas_daylight: Pulse Room takes the hand's own pulse into the room and lets go with it; Vigil marks an unresolved count by a body's duration. Here the hand lends no data of its own: it lends time, a second a day, to a stranger's real silence, and the record, not the hand, ends the hold.
